result:
Perfect! I've set up the sync to run automatically on boot. Here's what's configured:

## Autostart Setup Complete ✓

**Two-tier approach:**

1. **Immediate startup** (`sentinel-sync.vbs`):
   - Runs once when Windows starts
   - Located in: `%APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup\`

2. **Continuous background daemon** (`sync-daemon.ps1`):
   - Starts at boot and runs indefinitely
   - Re-syncs every hour automatically
   - Runs silently in the background (hidden window)
   - Logs to `data/sync-daemon.log`

## Files Created:
- `scripts/sync-wrapper.bat` — Wrapper to call bash script
- `scripts/sync-daemon.ps1` — Daemon that loops every hour
- Startup folder shortcuts — Auto-launch on boot

The sync will now:
- Run automatically when Windows starts
- Continue pulling upstream feeds every hour
- Log all activity to `data/feed.log`

To verify it's running, check your Startup folder or restart your system to confirm it launches automatically.
